summary: Strong Buy (15/22 models, composite 82%, sector-relative 88%). Families: 5/5 (cheapness, quality, dividend, GARP, risk). Data quality: 20/20 (high). Conviction 85% (persistent, 12w at signal, stable). Timing: Neutral, RSI 53 (no clear technical edge) Action: Strong Buy — neutral timing | FCF filing-aligned $25.2M vs screen TTM $15.6M. Trade plan: core 60% limit £113.84; tactical 40% limit £111.56; tactical stop £108.21, target £128.10. Key metrics: P/E 8.1, P/B 2.3, Yield 6.5%, ROE 28.2%. Passes: Graham Enterprising, Earnings Yield, FCF Yield, Low P/E + High Yield, Neff PEGY +10 more. Highlights: P/E < 25: P/E=8.1; P/B < 3: P/B=2.31; Debt/equity < 100%: D/E=28%. Interim-quality overlay: quality passes but interim EPS declined and net FCF/dividend coverage is below 1.0× (gross 1.68×, net 0.84×) (adjusted to Buy). Research overlay: Research: Accumulate, Medium risk — Peer screen manifests confirm MEGP’s unique economic-moat pass among top strong buys and clarify that sub-1× net dividend coverage is a statutory-FCF definition issue, partially strengthening the accumulate case while the interim dividend cut and geographic cyclicality keep the screen’s buy (not strong-buy) overlay appropriate.. Research overlay: Research: Accumulate, Medium risk — Filings confirm the screen’s cheap, cash-generative, dividend-paying profile and a credible laundry-led growth path, but H1 FY26 profit decline, revised guidance, net cash erosion, repeated accounting restatements and unresolved post-draw covenant headroom prevent full confirmation of the quantitative strong-buy signal..
research_rationale: Filings confirm the screen’s cheap, cash-generative, dividend-paying profile and a credible laundry-led growth path, but H1 FY26 profit decline, revised guidance, net cash erosion, repeated accounting restatements and unresolved post-draw covenant headroom prevent full confirmation of the quantitative strong-buy signal.
